title: The son Andrew Ryan never knew about in BioShock
subject: ryan
description:
When did you figure out who Jack really was? 👇

The hidden link between Andrew Ryan and Jack in BioShock. Spoilers for BioShock.

scenes.text: Andrew Ryan's son was raised to kill him.
The boy's mother was Jasmine Jolene, a dancer at Fleet Hall in Rapture.
Ryan's rival, the smuggler Frank Fontaine, paid her for the embryo.
Scientists aged the child fast and trained him to obey one phrase: would you kindly.
That child was Jack, the player. In 1960 his plane went down right beside Ryan's lighthouse.
Every bathysphere in Rapture was locked to Ryan's genetic code, and his son's opened all of them.
